Senses.Explanation: All that wriggles with spirit — the corpus's one compound for every living being, and the floor the masters lay their claims on: even here, nothing is missing. Huangbo Xiyuan's assembly: mind itself is the buddha — above to the buddhas, below to all that wriggles with spirit, all have buddha-nature, one and the same mind-substance, which is why Bodhidharma came from the west transmitting the one-mind way, pointing straight at every being's already-being-buddha; Wuzu Fayan, settling the stone-Buddha case for his hall, makes his second sample: east Purvavideha a buddha, south Jambudvipa a buddha, west Aparagodaniya a buddha, north Uttarakuru a buddha, grass and trees a buddha, all that wriggles with spirit a buddha — since so, what do you call a sentient being? — and then gives each continent back to itself, gives the grass and trees back to the grass and trees, gives all that wriggles back to all that wriggles: things keep to their own stations, the world's marks abide forever. Pu'an Yinsu's small assembly: all that wriggles with spirit is fully endowed with buddha-nature, fallen into a single dust-grain, unable to awaken itself — only a buddha can know it; yet the great work is done and beings widely converted while deviant lines disorderly make sight and sound, deluding believers, founding buildings and raising images, a hundred kinds of bustle, profit coiling the body like hemp and millet; and Guting Shanjian, giving the precepts to the fourfold assembly: the buddhas' precept wonderfully seals the one mind, all that wriggles with spirit from the start lacks nothing — indeed the whole body of it is the precept, let alone humans and gods — this precept is your one thought of pure mind; outside mind no precept, outside the precept no mind. Mi'an Xianjie, receiving the emperor's incense at the opening of the hall: this is no worldly sandalwood nor overseas eaglewood — where it burns, auspice and omen; mountains, rivers, and the great earth rejoice, all that wriggles with spirit is universally perfumed by right view; and Tianyin Yuanxiu, at the memorial for the layman's father, ladders the seat of settling: know where the departed settles and you know your own; know your own and you know the buddhas' and patriarchs'; know the buddhas' and patriarchs' and you know where all that wriggles with spirit settles — there, buddha and beings are equal, affliction and awakening equal, birth-and-death and quiescence equal, the western quarter and the east equal. Baiyu Jingsi, at the turning of spring: the sun has legs, spreading the great earth's radiance; creation is impartial, the workings of the yang openly shown — sun and moon flower on the unbudding branch, the phoenix dances in the shadowless grove, all that wriggles with spirit is moistened, grass and fiber and mustard all drenched — to know the meaning of buddha-nature, watch the season's cause; the season now come, where is the meaning of buddha-nature? The wooden horse neighs open the moon under the waves, the mud ox ploughs through the smoke on the ridge; and Yushan Shangsi: one leaf falls, heaven and earth autumn; one flower opens, the world arises — the hundred-thousand buddhas turn the root wheel here, the hundred-thousand patriarchs manifest the form-body here, thus mountains and rivers are buddha, grass-mustard and man-and-beast are buddha, scale and feather are buddha, all that wriggles with spirit is buddha.
